title: La Heredera de Comalcalco, VISTA STORIES
comment: cacao-comalcalco (VISTA): comedor de una hacienda cacaotera en Comalcalco, Tabasco. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ROSARIO_BENITEZ: Mexican woman from the mountains, 38 years old, sun-tanned brown skin, thick curly black hair tied back with loose strands, no makeup, strong and calm, a plain white cotton blouse with rolled-up sleeves, khaki work trousers, worn brown boots, her hands empty.
chars.ARTURO_GARRIDO: Mexican man, 58 years old, light skin, receding grey hair combed back, gold-rimmed glasses, a cream linen suit over a light-blue shirt with no tie, brown shoes, his hands empty.
chars.LEONOR_GARRIDO: Mexican woman, 56 years old, fair skin, auburn hair in a short neat bob, a pearl necklace, a lilac silk blouse, white trousers, beige flats, her hands empty.
chars.EUSEBIO_MAY: Mexican man from Tabasco, old majordomo of the hacienda, 72 years old, dark-brown skin, short white hair, a thin white beard, a beige long-sleeve shirt buttoned to the top, dark trousers, sandals, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_HACIENDACACAO: Dining room of an old cacao hacienda in Comalcalco, Tabasco, at midday: high ceilings, a slow ceiling fan, tall wooden doors with open shutters to a green garden of cacao trees, a long dark-wood dining table with white plates and a clay basket of tortillas, a wooden sideboard, humid tropical light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
